epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration of a payment gateway, specifically Stripe, to enable credit card payments and subscription management

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Enable credit card payments through Stripe integration
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Implement Stripe API for credit card payments

tasks.title: Develop payment form with credit card input fields
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form for customers to enter credit card details

tasks.title: Implement payment processing and error handling
tasks.description: Handle payment processing and error handling for credit card payments

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Enable subscription management through Stripe integration
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to update their subscription plans and billing information
The system cancels subscriptions and stops recurring payments when requested by the customer

tasks.title: Implement subscription management API with Stripe
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management

tasks.title: Develop subscription management UI for customers
tasks.description: Create a user interface for customers to manage their subscriptions

tasks.title: Handle webhook events for subscription updates and cancellations
tasks.description: Implement webhook handling for subscription events

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive email notifications and generate receipts for successful payments, so that I can track and verify transactions
stories.description: Enable email notifications and receipt generation for successful payments
acceptance_criteria: The system sends email notifications to customers and administrators for successful payments
The system generates receipts for successful payments and makes them available to customers

tasks.title: Implement email notification system for payment events
tasks.description: Develop an email notification system for payment events

tasks.title: Generate receipts for successful payments
tasks.description: Create a receipt generation system for successful payments

tasks.title: Integrate receipt generation with payment processing
tasks.description: Integrate receipt generation with payment processing and email notifications

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using my email and password, so that I can access the application
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, and redirect them to the dashboard after successful authentication
acceptance_criteria: The system redirects the user to the dashboard after successful login
The system displays an error message when the user enters an incorrect email or password
The system remembers the user's login credentials for a specified period

tasks.title: Implement email and password login functionality
tasks.description: Create a login form that accepts email and password, and authenticates the user using the backend API

tasks.title: Integrate with backend API for user authentication
tasks.description: Create API calls to authenticate the user and retrieve the user's data

tasks.title: Implement login form validation and error handling
tasks.description: Validate user input and display error messages for invalid email or password

stories.title: As a new user, I want to signup for an account, so that I can use the application
stories.description: The system should allow new users to signup for an account, and send a verification email to the user's email address
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a verification email to the user's email address after signup
The system displays an error message when the user enters an invalid email or password
The system creates a new user account after successful signup and verification

tasks.title: Implement user signup form and validation
tasks.description: Create a signup form that accepts user data, and validates user input

tasks.title: Integrate with email service for verification emails
tasks.description: Create API calls to send verification emails to the user's email address

tasks.title: Implement user account creation and database storage
tasks.description: Create a new user account and store user data in the database

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, and send a password reset link to the user's email address
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a password reset link to the user's email address
The system displays an error message when the user enters an invalid email
The system updates the user's password after successful password reset

tasks.title: Implement password reset form and validation
tasks.description: Create a password reset form that accepts user email, and validates user input

tasks.title: Integrate with email service for password reset emails
tasks.description: Create API calls to send password reset links to the user's email address

tasks.title: Implement password update functionality
tasks.description: Update the user's password in the database after successful password reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, so that I can access the application without creating a new account
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, and redirect them to the dashboard after successful authentication
acceptance_criteria: The system redirects the user to the dashboard after successful OAuth login
The system displays an error message when the user's OAuth credentials are invalid
The system creates a new user account after successful OAuth login if the user does not have an existing account

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login with Google
tasks.description: Create API calls to authenticate the user using Google OAuth

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login with GitHub
tasks.description: Create API calls to authenticate the user using GitHub OAuth

tasks.title: Integrate OAuth login with the application
tasks.description: Create a login button that allows users to login using OAuth, and redirect them to the dashboard after successful authentication

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system to send transactional emails to users for important events, such as user signup, payment success, and password reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a welcome email after signing up, so that I can verify my email address and get started with the application
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to users after they sign up, with a verification link to confirm their email address
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a welcome email to the user's registered email address within 5 minutes of signup
The welcome email contains a verification link that redirects to the application's login page
The email template is customizable and can be edited by the administrator

tasks.title: Design and implement the welcome email template
tasks.description: Create a customizable email template for the welcome email, with placeholders for the user's name and verification link

tasks.title: Integrate the email template with the user signup workflow
tasks.description: Modify the user signup workflow to trigger the sending of the welcome email after successful signup

tasks.title: Test the welcome email functionality
tasks.description: Test the welcome email functionality, including the email template, verification link, and email delivery

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a password reset email when I forget my password, so that I can reset my password and regain access to the application
stories.description: The system should send a password reset email to users when they request a password reset, with a link to reset their password
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a password reset email to the user's registered email address within 2 minutes of the password reset request
The password reset email contains a link that redirects to the password reset page
The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once

tasks.title: Design and implement the password reset email template
tasks.description: Create a customizable email template for the password reset email, with a placeholder for the password reset link

tasks.title: Integrate the password reset email with the password reset workflow
tasks.description: Modify the password reset workflow to trigger the sending of the password reset email after the user requests a password reset

tasks.title: Test the password reset email functionality
tasks.description: Test the password reset email functionality, including the email template, password reset link, and password reset workflow

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a payment receipt email after making a payment, so that I can verify my payment and keep a record of my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt email to users after they make a payment, with details of the payment and a receipt number
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a payment receipt email to the user's registered email address within 5 minutes of the payment
The payment receipt email contains the payment amount, payment method, and receipt number
The email template is customizable and can be edited by the administrator

tasks.title: Design and implement the payment receipt email template
tasks.description: Create a customizable email template for the payment receipt email, with placeholders for the payment details

tasks.title: Integrate the payment receipt email with the payment workflow
tasks.description: Modify the payment workflow to trigger the sending of the payment receipt email after successful payment

tasks.title: Test the payment receipt email functionality
tasks.description: Test the payment receipt email functionality, including the email template, payment details, and email delivery

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to integrate the email notification system with SendGrid or AWS SES, so that I can send emails to users reliably and efficiently
stories.description: The system should integrate with SendGrid or AWS SES to send emails to users, with support for email templates and customizable email content
acceptance_criteria: The system can send emails to users using SendGrid or AWS SES
The system supports customizable email templates and content
The system can handle email delivery failures and retries

tasks.title: Research and evaluate SendGrid and AWS SES integration options
tasks.description: Research and evaluate the integration options for SendGrid and AWS SES, including API documentation and code examples

tasks.title: Implement SendGrid or AWS SES integration
tasks.description: Implement the integration with SendGrid or AWS SES, including API calls and error handling

tasks.title: Test the email delivery functionality
tasks.description: Test the email delivery functionality, including email sending, delivery, and failure handling

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The administrator should be able to create, update, and delete users from the dashboard
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a list of all users
The administrator can create a new user with a unique username and password
The administrator can update an existing user's details
The administrator can delete a user and all associated data

tasks.title: Design and implement user management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing users

tasks.title: Develop user management API endpoints
tasks.description: Create API endpoints for creating, updating, and deleting users

tasks.title: Implement user management business logic
tasks.description: Write code to handle user management operations and validate user data

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to view analytics, so that I can understand platform usage
stories.description: The administrator should be able to view analytics dashboards to monitor platform usage
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a summary of platform usage metrics
The administrator can view detailed analytics reports
The analytics data is updated in real-time
The administrator can filter analytics data by date range

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for viewing analytics

tasks.title: Develop analytics API endpoints
tasks.description: Create API endpoints for retrieving analytics data

tasks.title: Implement analytics data processing
tasks.description: Write code to process and update analytics data in real-time

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify issues
stories.description: The administrator should be able to monitor system health metrics to identify potential issues
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a summary of system health metrics
The administrator can view detailed system health reports
The system health data is updated in real-time
The administrator can set alerts for system health issues

tasks.title: Design and implement system health monitoring UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for monitoring system health

tasks.title: Develop system health API endpoints
tasks.description: Create API endpoints for retrieving system health data

tasks.title: Implement system health alerting
tasks.description: Write code to send alerts for system health issues

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to configure the platform, so that I can customize settings
stories.description: The administrator should be able to configure platform settings to customize the user experience
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a list of configurable settings
The administrator can update platform settings
The platform settings are validated to prevent errors
The administrator can reset platform settings to default values

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing platform settings

tasks.title: Develop configuration management API endpoints
tasks.description: Create API endpoints for retrieving and updating platform settings

tasks.title: Implement configuration validation
tasks.description: Write code to validate platform settings to prevent errors
